exceptions.justification: The actual separate writer owns a cloned fixture path and reports its result over recv_timeout using one unchanged absolute 30-second budget. Its exact JoinHandle is joined only after that same handle is_finished; deadline/error paths retain the fixture rather than removing files under an unresolved writer. The isolated parent has the same total elapsed budget, reserves its last second for exact-child kill/try_wait reaping, and reports an unreaped child as failure. No scoped-thread implicit join or unconditional child wait remains; all unsafe-intermediate and atomic publication assertions remain.
